context: Two adults grocery-shopping discuss food prices
purpose: Teach: たんぱく/物価/不景気/危険性/ハンドル/急速/細かい/アクセス

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 最近、物価が本当に上がりましたね。卵まで高くなって驚きました。
lines.en: Prices have really gone up lately. Even eggs have gotten expensive — I was shocked.
lines.style: Worried housewife tone, lowered voice while comparing labels on the shelf

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: 本当に。不景気がずっと続いているのに、値段だけ急速に上がっていくのよね。
lines.en: Truly. The recession just keeps going, yet only the prices keep climbing rapidly.
lines.style: Sighing older neighbor, knowing and slightly resigned cadence

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お肉も高いから、最近はたんぱく質を豆腐や納豆で取るようにしてるんです。
lines.en: Meat is expensive too, so lately I've been getting my protein from tofu and natto.
lines.style: Practical mother explaining household strategy, soft conversational pace

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: 賢いわ。私なんて安いお店を探して走り回るから、カートのハンドルを握る手も疲れちゃって。
lines.en: Smart. Me, I run around hunting for cheap shops, so even the hand gripping the cart handle gets tired.
lines.style: Light self-deprecating laugh, hand resting wearily on the shopping cart

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: わかります。値札の細かい字を見るのも一苦労で、毎回眼鏡が必要で。
lines.en: I understand. Even reading the fine print on price tags is a struggle — I need glasses every time.
lines.style: Chuckling commiseration, squinting at a price tag as she speaks

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: そうそう。それに安いお店ってアクセスが悪い場所ばかりで、バスに乗らないと行けないのよ。
lines.en: Right, right. And the cheap shops always have bad access — you have to take the bus to get there.
lines.style: Mildly complaining, gesturing vaguely toward the store entrance

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: このままだと家計が苦しくなる危険性もあるから、夫とアプリで予算を共有してるんですよ。
lines.en: At this rate there's a real risk the household budget gets tight, so my husband and I share a budget app.
lines.style: Confiding tone, slightly proud of the practical solution

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: あら、いいアイデアね。うちも始めようかしら。今度教えてくださる？
lines.en: Oh, what a good idea. Maybe we should start that too. Would you teach me sometime?
lines.style: Brightening, leaning in with genuine interest and a warm smile
